from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

# Define correct qubit/clbit dimensions based on the user request
qc = QuantumCircuit(4, 3)

# Apply H gate to qubits 0,1,2
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.h(2)

# Apply X gate then H gate to ancilla qubit 3
qc.x(3)
qc.h(3)

# Apply CNOT gates
qc.cx(0, 3)
qc.cx(2, 3)

# Apply H gate again to qubits 0,1,2
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.h(2)

# Measure ONLY input qubits 0,1,2
qc.measure([0, 1, 2], [0, 1, 2])
